verdict: Instant noodle soup is lower in calories, but low in protein. Add egg or chicken to make it more filling.
why: Instant noodle soup is about 380 kcal per packet. Maggi goreng from a shop is about 600 kcal.
Instant noodle soup has about 15 g fat, Maggi goreng 27 g, because it's fried again in oil.
Maggi goreng has more protein (about 18 g vs 8 g) because of the egg and chicken. Plain noodle soup makes you hungry again quickly.
When you cook at home, you control what goes in. At a shop, the portion and oil depend on the cook.
when_a: Instant noodle soup is okay as a quick dinner at home. Add egg, vegetables and use half the seasoning if you like.
when_b: Maggi goreng is okay for a lepak session at the mamak once in a while. Ask for less oil and add an egg.
tip: Cook instant noodle soup with 1-2 eggs and a handful of vegetables. Calories go up a little, but you stay full longer.

faq.q: Can I eat instant noodles while trying to lose weight?
faq.a: Yes, once in a while. Add protein and vegetables, and don't make it your main meal every day.

faq.q: Why is Maggi goreng higher in calories?
faq.a: It's fried in oil and usually has egg and chicken. So calories and fat go up, even though protein goes up too.
